correctness.rationale: Cycle removal gives a uniform fixed-root forest. Deleting r prescribed nonroot leaves and independently restoring their parents gives the ratio (1−r/n)^(n−k−1) of compatible forests, which determines the joint indicators and the occupancy law; the all-cycle case has no leaves. Cycle counts give the conditioned Poisson law, and consecutive conditional means have strictly negative differences in k. On the √n cycle scale a Taylor expansion yields (1−x²)/(2e); the consecutive differences also give the global bound |mₙ,ₖ−n/e|≤C(1+k²/n). Poisson moment bounds then justify the mixed moment and covariance limit using E|Z|³=2E|Z|. For the conditional CLT, Fourier inversion in total Poisson count at its mean conditions the joint Gaussian limit: the marked-box outcomes (1,0) and (2,0) bound the integrand modulus by exp(−cn u²) uniformly in the other Fourier parameter near zero, allowing the scaled Gaussian integral. The Schur complement is e⁻¹−2e⁻². Uniformity for bounded k/√n and tightness give the independent joint limit. Vacancy indicators have nonpositive pair covariance, bounding the exact conditional variance by n/4 for the variance limit. Independent replay, python3 /workspace/frozen_math_replay.py 1, enumerates fixed-root parent maps for n=3,…,7 and checks the joint counts, including 68,295 graphs at n=7. The finite check does not establish the limit.
residual_risks: The convergence is weak, not a local limit assertion about the graph statistics.

evidence: Moon gives the fixed-root count. Noy and Janson–Knuth–Łuczak–Pittel give unmarked rooted-tree constructions. Drmota et al. address more general graph classes, not conditioning on a unique cycle length. 3ee31f6dc5e8 gives a finer factorial-moment law resolving shallow versus deep leaves.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The classical literature supplies ingredients rather than the evaluated half-normal mixed covariance. The indexed shallow/deep refinement contains the total conditional leaf law upon summing the two counts but studies different mixed asymptotics.

evidence: The mapping proof is uniform over cyclic permutations at fixed root set and size; conditional occupancy is unchanged on restricting to one cycle. Its unconditional coefficient differs because the mapping core has a Rayleigh rather than half-normal limit. The exact unicyclic entry already supplies the distinct half-normal coefficient and joint normal/half-normal law.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: One must not transfer the unconditional mapping covariance; the same-ensemble result settles that part independently. The independent-copy covariance identity extends any strictly decreasing conditional expectation to all nonconstant nondecreasing test functions. The PGF is a repackaging of the occupancy distribution, and the extra mean/variance statements are routine consequences of the same moment bounds and exact law.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Multiplication by r! converts binomial moments to falling-factorial moments. A connected mapping with its sole directed cycle of length ≥3 gives an undirected unicyclic graph; conversely each such graph has exactly two orientations of its cycle and uniquely oriented trees toward it. Indegree zero in the mapping is precisely noncycle degree one in the graph.

originality.rationale: A distinct published indexed record, 9f53c3cb582f, covers the same ensemble, cycle law, exact occupancy law, strict conditional regression, independent Gaussian/half-normal limit, quadratic conditional mean shift and sharp raw covariance coefficient. Allowing nonconstant nondecreasing tests instead of strictly increasing ones follows immediately from the same strict regression and positive support. The generating function and unconditional mean and variance limits follow from the shared occupancy law and moment analysis; they do not supply a distinct substantial remainder. In addition, 007c2a04bfe9 already contains the actual fixed-root conditional occupancy calculation in mapping language, which transfers exactly to one directed cycle of length at least three and then by forgetting the cycle orientation. This is a finding of demonstrated coverage, not a finding about which version was first public: index dates alone do not establish chronology or derivation.
residual_risks: The exact publication order of the separate versions and historical priority were not determined.
Other published marked generating functions could also encode the law; this is not needed for the coverage finding.
